rust_summary: cancelling a play packet from the server before the game handles it (`native_client_packet_pre`).
doc_summary: A play packet from the server is about to be handled, decoded, in the order the server sent them: `native_client_packet_pre(packet, cancel)`. Set `cancel` and the game never handles it, so a mod can hide a title, a sound or a particle burst (`SetTitleText`, `Sound`, `LevelParticles`). `native_client_packet` has already heard the packet, cancelled or not. Packets the network thread handles itself are not heard, as for `native_client_packet`. A cancelled chunk, entity or inventory packet leaves that state as it was. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_packet_pre@.
